comment:
Rules that don't really fit into one category, covers a wide range of behaviour.

- Beta Features (Bibs, 3 point turns)
- Allow using Skirmish/Multiplayer options in single player
- Building behaviours

rules.name: SmartDefence
rules.comment: Human controlled units retaliate when they come under fire and they will also try to crush infantry if possible.

rules.name: McvRedeployable
rules.comment: Construction yards can be deconstructed by selecting them and clicking nearby on the map.

rules.name: VehiclesDoThreePointTurns
rules.comment: Make wheeled vehicles do 3 point turns.

rules.name: ShowBibsOnBuildings
rules.comment: Show little dirt bibs on buildings (if turned off, overrides any rules for indiviual buildings)

rules.name: ShowCivilianBuildingNames
rules.comment: - (C&C remastered seems to show the names regardless of this switch)

rules.name: OnlyAllowNukeIfAllPartsHaveBeenCollected
rules.comment: Only give the player the nuke at the end of Nod campaign if all crates were collected

rules.name: OnlyAllowUsingOneNukePerScenario
rules.comment: Remove the nuclear superpower after 1 shot

rules.name: HelipadsAndAircraftBoughtSeperately
rules.comment: Helipads do not come with a chopper, they are also cheaper.

rules.name: DestroyedBuildingsHaveSurvivors
rules.comment: When a building is destroyed, should there be survivors left behind?
